read_scope.notes: Read all text on PDF pages 1–22, including References and Appendices A–G. Visually inspected every rendered PDF page, all five figures and all ten tables; enlarged Tables 3 and 7 to verify their typography. Consulted the frozen paper.tex, specificity_results.tex, specificity_model_table.tex, specificity_review_table.tex and specificity_component_supplement.tex for notation, locations and table formatting. Verified the supplied PDF SHA256 directly. Technical appendices were treated as optional depth, not prerequisites for understanding the main narrative. No other review records or manuscript versions were read.

score_reasons.expression: Excellent, precise English with localized opportunities for lighter phrasing. Section 4.1's lightness example and three idealized generators explain the scores economically; Sections 5.1 and 5.4 translate numerical differences into their practical interpretation. Terminology remains consistent across the primary results and diagnostics. The abstract's long calibration sentence is the clearest remaining concentration of procedural detail.
score_reasons.structure: The main text has a particularly effective progression from the Monet–Sisley motivation to the six-clause design, feature meanings, contrast construction, primary results and explanatory diagnostics. Section 5.1 establishes the declared result before Sections 5.3–5.5 examine pair coverage, calibration and reference corrections. Technical derivations, complete comparison families and earlier cohorts occupy clearly labeled appendices. Table 4 and the conclusion keep the source-sensitive Sunburst comparison visible. No important structural gap prevents a standalone reading of the main text.
score_reasons.new_reader_understanding: The study and reference target are readily recoverable without repository access. The abstract names the panels and intervention; Section 3.2 specifies all six prompt conditions; Table 1 gives everyday interpretations of the feature families. Section 4.1 supplies intuition before notation, and Section 4.2 explicitly distinguishes the D=1 theoretical predictor from the generic-painting arm. Figures 1–3 and Table 3 make the central comparisons inspectable, with clear baseline meanings and retrospective labels. The abstract's compressed account of scalar calibration could be easier on a first reading, but the main text resolves it fully.
score_reasons.engagement: The consequential distinction between eliciting a name response and reproducing painter differences sustains the narrative without hype. Figure 1 rewards comparison across named and control outputs; Figure 2's magnified Monet/Sisley/Pissarro views and Figure 3's paired heatmaps expose the uneven alignment. The two ordering changes in Section 5.4 explain why the metric's target matters. The exact deletion-check range in that section briefly slows the explanatory thread and would work better in the existing technical appendix.

strengths: The introduction's Monet–Sisley example makes the evaluation problem concrete: a generic painting shift can improve proximity to both collections without reproducing their difference.
Section 4.1 explains both centering and the aligned-response/error distinction before introducing equations, including the memorable D values 1, 0 and 1 for no, exact and doubled contrasts.
The primary finding is explicit and appropriately bounded: all aligned-response intervals are positive, while even the lowest-error model's nominal interval includes the no-contrast benchmark.

The manuscript differentiates original scene-wise error, error after averaging scenes, and held-out scalar calibration through Table 3 and specific model comparisons, while stating that calibration does not change images.
Source correction is integrated into the main story through Table 4 and the conclusion; the lost Sunburst comparison and retrospective GPT Image 1 comparison are described candidly.

Figures and captions are readable and instructive. The main image panel includes both controls, the geometry figure uses common axes and magnified detail, and the pair heatmaps state their numeric anchors and finite-sample caveat.

findings.issue: The calibration sentence combines the retrospective status, fitted parameter, 13-scene fitting scheme, omitted-scene evaluation, shrinkage mechanism and change in the lowest estimate in one long sentence. This is a localized density problem in an otherwise standalone abstract.
findings.reader_effect: A new reader must hold several procedural clauses before reaching the finding, just as the abstract is introducing the unfamiliar notion of a contrast multiplier.
findings.suggested_change: Replace it with two shorter sentences, for example: 'Retrospective calibration rescales each model’s painter differences using 13 scenes and scores the omitted scene. Reducing GPT Image 2’s excess contrast size shifts the lowest error estimate from FLUX.2 Max to GPT Image 2, without changing images.' Keep the one-multiplier specification in Section 4.4. This replacement is shorter than the current passage and preserves the 155-word ceiling.

findings.issue: After reporting the calibrated estimates and the 12-of-14 fold comparison, the paragraph introduces a second validation procedure and its exact −.189 to −.137 difference range immediately before the substantive scene-averaging example.
findings.reader_effect: The extra procedural and numerical detail briefly interrupts the clear explanation of why response strength and scene treatment change the ordering.
findings.suggested_change: In the main text, summarize that the mean advantage persists after deleting any scene and refitting the procedure, retaining the caution about panel stability and statistical superiority. Move the exact difference range to the existing deletion-check paragraph in Appendix C.2. Transfer rather than duplicate the detail so the paper remains within 22 pages.

summary: Excellent editorial communication of a deliberately bounded comparison of digital reference contrasts. The main text independently explains the experiment, metric meanings, primary finding and retrospective qualifications; the figures support the argument. Only localized compression and pacing refinements remain. No additional evidence or experiments are needed for these editorial improvements.
